summary.plain: The physicists from Karlsruhe, Oxford, London, Erlangen and Bonn who built and ran the KARMEN neutrino detector at the ISIS accelerator in England from 1990 to 2001.
summary.technical: Collaboration that built and operated the KARMEN liquid-scintillator neutrino detector at ISIS, Rutherford Appleton Laboratory, from 1990 (KARMEN 1) through the KARMEN 2 upgrade (1996-97) to the end of data taking in March 2001; publication affiliations include Karlsruhe, Oxford, London (Imperial College/QMW-area groups), Erlangen and Bonn.
